title: Synthesis and characterization of Ag-doped ZnO nanostructures and an assessment on their enhanced bacterial inhibition and photocatalytic degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16253-16263
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09660J, Paper

Vishwajeet. Aherkar, Ali Abdulmawjood Mohammed, Anmar A. Al-shimary, Rekha M. Ovhal, Shivaji Pawar, Ganesh Kamble, Panchsheela A. Ubale
In this study, we have synthesized zinc oxide (ZnO) and silver-doped zinc oxide nanoparticles with different molar concentrations of silver (1, 3, 5 and 7 mol%) using a simple and cost-effective sol–gel method.
